name: mentor
description: Know your Go code while a coding agent writes it: ask which type or function to use in plain words, and get a card for any symbol with who makes, calls and tests it, real uses, the package map and the path a call takes. All from the type checker, on your machine.

settings.label: Show uses above declarations
settings.description: One line above each Go type and function: how many things use it, how many tests reach it, how many types implement it. A click shows its card.

settings.label: Leave out
settings.description: Files to leave out of the index, comma-separated globs on paths from the folder: gen/**, *_mock.go. vendor and testdata are always left out.

settings.label: Build tags
settings.description: Read the code as go build -tags would, such as integration.

settings.label: Semantic search
settings.description: Find code by meaning as well as by words, with embeddings from a local Ollama. Nothing leaves your machine.

settings.label: Embedding model
settings.description: An embedding model Ollama has pulled, such as nomic-embed-text.
